children: Overview
Germany DIY retailer's preliminary Q2 sales rose 7.3% yr/yr, driven by robust customer demand
Adjusted EBIT for preliminary Q2 grew 12.8% despite ongoing cost pressure
Company maintained FY outlook, citing geopolitical risks and consumer sentiment uncertainty
Outlook
Hornbach expects FY 2026/27 net sales at or slightly above EUR 6,433.9 mln
Company maintains FY 2026/27 adjusted EBIT guidance at EUR 264.7 mln
Hornbach cites ongoing geopolitical risks as factors that may impact outlook
Result Drivers
CUSTOMER DEMAND - Company said Q2 sales growth was driven by robust customer demand
CALENDAR EFFECT - Additional 1.3 business days in the quarter contributed positively to sales, according to the company
COST PRESSURE - Adjusted EBIT rose despite ongoing cost pressure, per company statement
